title.sk: Kurací curry s jogurtom a ryžou basmati
title.en: Chicken curry with yogurt and basmati rice

description.sk: Jemne pikantné kura v smotanovo-paradajkovej omáčke plnej korenia.
description.en: Mildly spicy chicken in a creamy tomato sauce full of spices.

steps.sk: Kuracie prsia nakrájaj na kocky asi 3 cm. V mise ich zmiešaj so 150 g jogurtu, 1 lyžičkou garam masaly, 1 lyžičkou kurkumy a 1 lyžičkou soli a nechaj aspoň 15 minút marinovať (v chladničke pokojne aj cez noc). Jogurt mäso zjemní.
steps.en: Cut the chicken breasts into cubes of about 3 cm. In a bowl mix them with the 150 g of yoghurt, 1 teaspoon of garam masala, 1 teaspoon of turmeric and 1 teaspoon of salt and leave to marinate for at least 15 minutes (or overnight in the fridge). The yoghurt keeps the meat tender.

steps.sk: Medzitým nakrájaj 2 cibule nadrobno, 3 strúčiky cesnaku nasekaj a 15 g zázvoru ošúp (najľahšie hranou lyžičky) a najemno nastrúhaj. Ryžu basmati prepláchni na sitku, kým voda nie je takmer číra.
steps.en: Meanwhile finely chop the 2 onions, chop the 3 garlic cloves, and peel the 15 g of ginger (easiest with the edge of a teaspoon) and grate it finely. Rinse the basmati rice in a sieve until the water runs almost clear.

steps.sk: V širokom hrnci rozohrej 2 lyžice oleja na strednom ohni a cibuľu na ňom pomaly opekaj asi 8 minút, kým nie je mäkká a zlatohnedá – od nej závisí chuť omáčky. Pridaj cesnak, zázvor, 1 lyžičku rímskeho kmínu a ½ lyžičky čili a za stáleho miešania opekaj 1 minútu, kým korenie nezavonia.
steps.en: In a wide pot heat 2 tablespoons of oil over a medium heat and fry the onions slowly for about 8 minutes until soft and golden brown: the flavour of the sauce depends on it. Add the garlic, ginger, 1 teaspoon of cumin and ½ teaspoon of chili and stir for 1 minute until fragrant.

steps.sk: Prilej paradajky z konzervy, premiešaj a nechaj 10 minút prebublávať, kým omáčka nezhustne a olej sa na okrajoch nezačne oddeľovať. Medzitým uvar ryžu: zalej ju 450 ml vody so štipkou soli, priveď do varu a pod pokrievkou na najmenšom ohni var 12 minút, potom ju nechaj 5 minút dôjsť.
steps.en: Pour in the canned tomatoes, stir and let bubble for 10 minutes until the sauce thickens and the oil begins to separate at the edges. Meanwhile cook the rice: cover it with 450 ml of water and a pinch of salt, bring to the boil, cook covered on the lowest heat for 12 minutes, then let it stand for 5 minutes.

steps.sk: Pridaj mäso aj s marinádou, premiešaj a var na miernom ohni bez pokrievky 10 až 12 minút, občas premiešaj. Kuracie je hotové, keď je najväčšia kocka po prekrojení biela až do stredu a šťavnatá; teplomer ukáže 74 °C.
steps.en: Add the chicken with its marinade, stir and simmer uncovered over a low heat for 10 to 12 minutes, stirring now and then. It is done when the largest piece is white right through and juicy when cut; a thermometer reads 74 °C.

steps.sk: Vmiešaj 200 ml smotany a zvyšnú lyžičku garam masaly a prehrej, ale už nevar, aby sa smotana nezrazila. Ochutnaj a podľa potreby dosoľ. Podávaj s ryžou, posypané nasekaným koriandrom. V chladničke vydrží 3 dni.
steps.en: Stir in the 200 ml of cream and the remaining teaspoon of garam masala and heat through without boiling so the cream does not split. Taste and add salt if needed. Serve with the rice, sprinkled with chopped coriander. It keeps for 3 days in the fridge.

title.sk: Dal z červenej šošovice s kokosovým mliekom
title.en: Red lentil dal with coconut milk

description.sk: Krémový, hrejivý a úplne rastlinný – výborný na varenie do zásoby.
description.en: Creamy, warming and fully plant-based, ideal for batch cooking.

steps.sk: Šošovicu prepláchni na sitku pod studenou vodou, kým voda nie je číra – zbavíš ju prachu a peny. Cibuľu nakrájaj nadrobno, 3 strúčiky cesnaku nasekaj a 10 g zázvoru ošúp a najemno nastrúhaj.
steps.en: Rinse the lentils in a sieve under cold water until it runs clear; this removes dust and foam. Finely chop the onion, chop the 3 garlic cloves and peel and finely grate the 10 g of ginger.

steps.sk: V hrnci rozohrej 2 lyžice oleja na strednom ohni a cibuľu na ňom speň do mäkka a zlatista, asi 6 minút. Pridaj cesnak, zázvor, 1 lyžičku kurkumy a 1 lyžičku rímskeho kmínu a za stáleho miešania opekaj 1 minútu, kým korenie nezavonia.
steps.en: Heat 2 tablespoons of oil in a pot over a medium heat and soften the onion until golden, about 6 minutes. Add the garlic, ginger, 1 teaspoon of turmeric and 1 teaspoon of cumin and stir for 1 minute until fragrant.

steps.sk: Pridaj šošovicu, paradajky z konzervy, 1 lyžičku soli a 700 ml vody. Priveď do varu, zober penu z povrchu a na miernom ohni var 20 minút bez pokrievky. Často miešaj až ku dnu – rozvarená šošovica sa ľahko prichytí. Je hotová, keď sa rozpadá a dal je hustý ako kaša.
steps.en: Add the lentils, the canned tomatoes, 1 teaspoon of salt and 700 ml of water. Bring to the boil, skim off any foam and simmer uncovered over a low heat for 20 minutes. Stir often, right to the bottom, as softened lentils catch easily. It is done when the lentils fall apart and the dal is as thick as porridge.

steps.sk: Medzitým uvar ryžu: 250 g ryže prepláchni, zalej 375 ml vody so štipkou soli, priveď do varu a na najmenšom ohni pod pokrievkou var 12 minút. Potom ju nechaj 5 minút dôjsť a prehrab vidličkou.
steps.en: Meanwhile cook the rice: rinse the 250 g of rice, cover with 375 ml of water and a pinch of salt, bring to the boil and cook covered on the lowest heat for 12 minutes. Then let it stand for 5 minutes and fluff with a fork.

steps.sk: Do dalu vmiešaj 200 ml kokosového mlieka a 1 lyžičku garam masaly a povar ešte 3 minúty. Ak je príliš hustý, prilej trochu horúcej vody. Ochutnaj, dosoľ a dochuť citrónovou šťavou.
steps.en: Stir the 200 ml of coconut milk and 1 teaspoon of garam masala into the dal and simmer for 3 more minutes. If it is too thick, add a little hot water. Taste, add salt and finish with lemon juice.

steps.sk: Podávaj s ryžou, posypané nasekaným koriandrom. Dal pri státí hustne, pri ohrievaní ho zrieď vodou. V chladničke vydrží 4 dni, zamrazený až 3 mesiace.
steps.en: Serve with the rice, sprinkled with chopped coriander. The dal thickens as it stands, so loosen it with water when reheating. It keeps for 4 days in the fridge or up to 3 months frozen.

description.sk: Korenisté cícerové curry so špenátom, hotové za pol hodiny.
description.en: A spicy chickpea curry with spinach, ready in half an hour.

steps.sk: Cícer sceď a prepláchni na sitku. 2 cibule nakrájaj nadrobno, 3 strúčiky cesnaku nasekaj a 15 g zázvoru ošúp a nastrúhaj najemno.
steps.en: Drain the chickpeas and rinse them in a sieve. Finely chop the 2 onions, chop the 3 garlic cloves and peel and finely grate the 15 g of ginger.

steps.sk: V širokom hrnci rozohrej 2 lyžice oleja na strednom ohni a cibuľu na ňom pomaly opekaj asi 8 minút do zlatohneda. Čím tmavšia (ale nie spálená) cibuľa, tým plnšia chuť omáčky.
steps.en: Heat 2 tablespoons of oil in a wide pot over a medium heat and fry the onions slowly for about 8 minutes until golden brown. The darker the onion (without burning), the deeper the sauce.

steps.sk: Pridaj cesnak, zázvor, 1 lyžičku rímskeho kmínu, 1 lyžičku mletého koriandra, ½ lyžičky kurkumy a ½ lyžičky čili. Za stáleho miešania opekaj 1 minútu, kým korenie nezavonia; ak sa prichytáva, pridaj lyžicu vody.
steps.en: Add the garlic, ginger, 1 teaspoon of cumin, 1 teaspoon of ground coriander, ½ teaspoon of turmeric and ½ teaspoon of chili. Stir for 1 minute until fragrant; if it sticks, add a spoonful of water.

steps.sk: Prilej paradajky z konzervy a pridaj cícer, 1 lyžičku soli a 150 ml vody. Priveď do varu a na miernom ohni var 15 minút. V polovici varenia rozpuč asi štvrtinu cícera o stenu hrnca – omáčka zhustne a bude krémová.
steps.en: Pour in the canned tomatoes and add the chickpeas, 1 teaspoon of salt and 150 ml of water. Bring to the boil and simmer over a low heat for 15 minutes. Halfway through, crush about a quarter of the chickpeas against the side of the pot so the sauce thickens and turns creamy.

steps.sk: Vmiešaj 2 lyžičky garam masaly a špenát a miešaj asi 1 minútu, kým špenát nezavädne. Dochuť 1 lyžicou citrónovej šťavy a podľa potreby soľou.
steps.en: Stir in 2 teaspoons of garam masala and the spinach and stir for about 1 minute until the spinach wilts. Finish with 1 tablespoon of lemon juice and salt to taste.

steps.sk: Podávaj s pitou ohriatou na suchej panvici alebo s ryžou. V chladničke vydrží 4 dni a na druhý deň chutí ešte lepšie.
steps.en: Serve with pita warmed in a dry pan, or with rice. It keeps for 4 days in the fridge and tastes even better the next day.

title.sk: Aloo gobi – zemiaky s karfiolom na indický spôsob
title.en: Aloo gobi: Indian-style potatoes and cauliflower

description.sk: Suché zeleninové curry s kurkumou a rímskym kmínom.
description.en: A dry vegetable curry with turmeric and cumin.

steps.sk: Zemiaky ošúp a nakrájaj na kocky asi 2 cm. Karfiol rozober na malé ružičky, aby sa uvaril rovnako rýchlo ako zemiaky. Cibuľu nakrájaj nadrobno, paradajky na kocky, cesnak nasekaj a zázvor nastrúhaj.
steps.en: Peel the potatoes and cut them into cubes of about 2 cm. Break the cauliflower into small florets so it cooks as fast as the potatoes. Finely chop the onion, dice the tomatoes, chop the garlic and grate the ginger.

steps.sk: V širokej panvici s pokrievkou rozohrej 3 lyžice oleja na strednom ohni, pridaj 1 lyžičku rímskeho kmínu a nechaj ho asi 30 sekúnd praskať, kým nezavonia. Pridaj cibuľu a opekaj ju 5 minút do zlatista.
steps.en: In a wide pan with a lid heat 3 tablespoons of oil over a medium heat, add 1 teaspoon of cumin and let it sizzle for about 30 seconds until fragrant. Add the onion and fry for 5 minutes until golden.

steps.sk: Pridaj zázvor, cesnak, 1 lyžičku kurkumy a ½ lyžičky čili a minútu miešaj. Pridaj zemiaky, premiešaj, aby sa obalili korením, a opekaj ich 5 minút, kým sa po okrajoch nezačnú zlatiť.
steps.en: Add the ginger, garlic, 1 teaspoon of turmeric and ½ teaspoon of chili and stir for a minute. Add the potatoes, toss to coat them in the spices and fry for 5 minutes until they start to colour at the edges.

steps.sk: Pridaj karfiol, paradajky, 1 lyžičku soli a 100 ml vody, prikry a na miernom ohni var 15 až 20 minút. Občas opatrne premiešaj a ak sa prichytáva, prilej lyžicu vody. Hotové je, keď nôž ľahko prejde zemiakmi aj karfiolom, ale kúsky sa nerozpadajú.
steps.en: Add the cauliflower, tomatoes, 1 teaspoon of salt and 100 ml of water, cover and cook over a low heat for 15 to 20 minutes. Stir gently now and then and add a spoonful of water if it sticks. It is done when a knife slides easily into the potatoes and cauliflower but the pieces still hold together.

steps.sk: Odkry, vmiešaj 1 lyžičku garam masaly a ak je na dne ešte tekutina, nechaj ju 2 minúty odpariť. Posyp koriandrom a podávaj samotné, s ryžou alebo s pitou. V chladničke vydrží 3 dni.
steps.en: Uncover, stir in 1 teaspoon of garam masala and, if there is liquid left, let it cook off for 2 minutes. Sprinkle with coriander and serve on its own or with rice or pita. It keeps for 3 days in the fridge.

title.sk: Palak tofu – špenátové curry s tofu
title.en: Palak tofu: spinach curry with tofu

description.sk: Rastlinná obdoba palak paneer: krémový špenát s korením a opečeným tofu.
description.en: A plant-based take on palak paneer: creamy spiced spinach with fried tofu.

steps.sk: Ryžu prepláchni, zalej 340 ml vody so štipkou soli, priveď do varu a pod pokrievkou na najmenšom ohni var 12 minút, potom ju nechaj 5 minút dôjsť. Tofu sceď, zabaľ do utierky a 5 minút ho zaťaž doskou, aby pustilo vodu – lepšie sa opečie.
steps.en: Rinse the rice, cover it with 340 ml of water and a pinch of salt, bring to the boil and cook covered on the lowest heat for 12 minutes, then let it stand for 5 minutes. Drain the tofu, wrap it in a tea towel and weigh it down with a board for 5 minutes so it releases water and browns better.

steps.sk: Tofu nakrájaj na kocky asi 2 cm. V panvici rozpáľ 1,5 lyžice oleja na strednom až vysokom ohni a kocky opekaj 6 až 8 minút, obracaj ich, kým nie sú zo všetkých strán zlatisté. Prelož ich na tanier a jemne osoľ.
steps.en: Cut the tofu into cubes of about 2 cm. Heat 1½ tablespoons of oil in a frying pan over a medium-high heat and fry the cubes for 6 to 8 minutes, turning them until golden on all sides. Transfer to a plate and salt lightly.

steps.sk: Špenát umy a daj ho do veľkého hrnca s 2 lyžicami vody. Prikry a na strednom ohni ho nechaj asi 3 minúty zavädnúť, raz premiešaj. Prelož ho aj so šťavou do mixéra a rozmixuj na hladké pyré.
steps.en: Wash the spinach and put it in a large pot with 2 tablespoons of water. Cover and let it wilt over a medium heat for about 3 minutes, stirring once. Transfer it with its liquid to a blender and blend to a smooth purée.

steps.sk: V tom istom hrnci rozohrej zvyšný olej a speň na ňom nadrobno nakrájanú cibuľu do zlatista, asi 5 minút. Pridaj nasekaný cesnak, nastrúhaný zázvor, 1 lyžičku rímskeho kmínu, ½ lyžičky kurkumy a ½ lyžičky čili a minútu miešaj.
steps.en: In the same pot heat the remaining oil and soften the finely chopped onion until golden, about 5 minutes. Add the chopped garlic, grated ginger, 1 teaspoon of cumin, ½ teaspoon of turmeric and ½ teaspoon of chili and stir for a minute.

steps.sk: Vmiešaj špenátové pyré, 150 ml kokosového mlieka, 1 lyžičku soli a 1 lyžičku garam masaly a 5 minút jemne povar. Pridaj tofu, zľahka premiešaj a nechaj ho 2 minúty prehriať. Podávaj s ryžou.
steps.en: Stir in the spinach purée, 150 ml of coconut milk, 1 teaspoon of salt and 1 teaspoon of garam masala and simmer gently for 5 minutes. Add the tofu, fold it in gently and let it heat through for 2 minutes. Serve with the rice.

description.sk: Severoindické domáce curry, sýte a lacné.
description.en: A North Indian home-style curry, filling and cheap.

steps.sk: Fazuľu sceď a prepláchni na sitku. 2 cibule nakrájaj nadrobno, 3 strúčiky cesnaku nasekaj a 15 g zázvoru ošúp a nastrúhaj.
steps.en: Drain and rinse the beans in a sieve. Finely chop the 2 onions, chop the 3 garlic cloves and peel and grate the 15 g of ginger.

steps.sk: V hrnci rozohrej 2 lyžice oleja na strednom ohni a cibuľu pomaly opekaj asi 8 minút do zlatohneda. Pridaj cesnak, zázvor, 1 lyžičku rímskeho kmínu, 1 lyžičku mletého koriandra a ½ lyžičky čili a minútu miešaj, kým korenie nezavonia.
steps.en: Heat 2 tablespoons of oil in a pot over a medium heat and fry the onions slowly for about 8 minutes until golden brown. Add the garlic, ginger, 1 teaspoon of cumin, 1 teaspoon of ground coriander and ½ teaspoon of chili and stir for a minute until fragrant.

steps.sk: Prilej paradajky z konzervy a var 8 minút, kým omáčka nezhustne a olej sa na okrajoch nezačne oddeľovať.
steps.en: Pour in the canned tomatoes and cook for 8 minutes until the sauce thickens and the oil starts to separate at the edges.

steps.sk: Pridaj fazuľu, 1 lyžičku soli a 250 ml vody a na miernom ohni var 15 minút. Asi štvrtinu fazule rozpuč o stenu hrnca, aby omáčka zhustla. Medzitým uvar ryžu: 250 g prepláchnutej ryže zalej 375 ml vody so štipkou soli, priveď do varu a pod pokrievkou na najmenšom ohni var 12 minút.
steps.en: Add the beans, 1 teaspoon of salt and 250 ml of water and simmer over a low heat for 15 minutes. Crush about a quarter of the beans against the side of the pot to thicken the sauce. Meanwhile cook the rice: cover the 250 g of rinsed rice with 375 ml of water and a pinch of salt, bring to the boil and cook covered on the lowest heat for 12 minutes.

steps.sk: Vmiešaj 1 lyžičku garam masaly, ochutnaj a dosoľ. Podávaj s ryžou, posypané koriandrom. V chladničke vydrží 4 dni, zamrazené až 3 mesiace.
steps.en: Stir in 1 teaspoon of garam masala, taste and add salt if needed. Serve with the rice, sprinkled with coriander. It keeps for 4 days in the fridge or up to 3 months frozen.

description.sk: Indická omeleta s cibuľou, paradajkou, čili a koriandrom.
description.en: An Indian omelette with onion, tomato, chili and coriander.

steps.sk: Štvrtinu cibule, polovicu paradajky a polovicu čili papričky nakrájaj na veľmi drobné kocky; z paradajky predtým vyber semienka so šťavou, aby omeleta nebola vodnatá. Ak nechceš veľkú pálivosť, odstráň semienka aj z čili. Koriander nasekaj.
steps.en: Cut a quarter of an onion, half a tomato and half a chili into very small dice; scoop the seeds and juice out of the tomato first so the omelette is not watery. Remove the chili seeds too if you do not want much heat. Chop the coriander.

steps.sk: V miske vidličkou rozšľahaj 3 vajcia so štipkou kurkumy a štipkou soli, kým sa žĺtky s bielkami úplne nespoja. Vmiešaj zeleninu a koriander.
steps.en: In a bowl beat the 3 eggs with a pinch of turmeric and a pinch of salt with a fork until the yolks and whites are fully combined. Stir in the vegetables and coriander.

steps.sk: V panvici s priemerom asi 22 cm rozohrej 1 lyžičku oleja na strednom ohni, kým sa neleskne. Vlej vajcia, rozotri ich po celej ploche a nechaj 2 minúty piecť, kým spodok nie je zlatistý a vrch takmer stuhnutý. Okraje podvihuj stierkou a nechaj pod ne stiecť tekuté vajce.
steps.en: Heat 1 teaspoon of oil in a frying pan about 22 cm wide over a medium heat until it shimmers. Pour in the eggs, spread them over the whole pan and cook for 2 minutes until the base is golden and the top almost set. Lift the edges with a spatula and let the runny egg flow underneath.

steps.sk: Omeletu stierkou obráť (alebo ju preklop pomocou taniera) a dopeč ešte asi 1 minútu. Podávaj hneď, napríklad s opečeným chlebom alebo pitou.
steps.en: Turn the omelette with a spatula (or flip it using a plate) and cook for about 1 more minute. Serve at once, for example with toast or pita.
